svg.title: Crossbow item workflows without and with enforced verification.
svg.desc: Reconstruction of recorded workflows using native Minecraft item sprites. The crossbow recipe is missing its tripwire hook. Direct production fails and retries. In the assisted enforced run a fresh isolated test detects the fault, the agent selects the hook-crafting insertion, retests successfully, and produces a crossbow with its matching receipt. A branch shows the actual hook ingredients: iron ingot, stick and plank.

g.text: Native item sprites reconstruct the logged workflow; this is not an in-game inventory screen.
